Table 1 from the roll-to-roll manufacturing perspective lists the following for the Co-Free NFA cathode technology:

| Process Technology or Cell Chemistry Modification | Areal Capacity Improvement (mAh/cm^2) | Calendered Electrode Thickness (μm) | Specific Capacity Improvement (mAh/g) | Estimated Energy Density Improvement (Wh/kg) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Section 7 – Co-Free NFA | 4–6 | 65–100 | 180 | 250–275 |

The original NFA paper reports a first-cycle discharge capacity of ≈205 mAh g^− 1 for the NFA 811 variant, which is the lowest-capacity variant among those reported.
